policies.original_text: Klimarat: Klimaschutz ist so dringend und muss umgesetzt werden, auch wenn zeitnah keine sozialen Ausgleichsmaßnahmen möglich sind.

policies.text: The energy transition urgently needs a boost to infrastructure expansion (by grid operators), otherwise energy cannot be transmitted!
policies.original_text: Energiewende benötigt unbedingt einen Booster im Ausbau der Infrastruktur (Netzbetreiber), sonst kann Energie nicht übertragen werden!

policies.text: Smaller apartments and row houses instead of large detached single-family homes in the countryside without adequate public transport.
policies.original_text: Kleinere Wohnungen, Reihenhäuser anstatt große alleinstehende Einfamilienhäuser im Grünen ohne ausreichenden öffentlichen Verkehr.

policies.text: Renewables must also have a positive PEF when assessed holistically. Right now there’s too much greenwashing and performative action.
policies.original_text: Erneuerbare müssen auch einen ganzheitlich betrachteten positiven PEF haben. Derzeit dabei zuviel Green Washing und Aktionismus.

policies.text: We need baseload-capable power plants, not environmentally harmful wind and solar power plants that make us dependent on the weather.
policies.original_text: Wir brauchen grundlastfähige Kraftwerke, keine umweltschädlichen Wind- und Sonnenkraftwerke, die uns vom Wetter abhängig machen.

policies.text: Create opportunities for participation in wind power projects, see Greenland. A good, green investment that pays off many times over.
policies.original_text: Möglichkeit zur Beteiligung an Windkraftanlagen schaffen, siehe Grönland. Gute, grüne Investition die sich mehrfach auszahlt.

policies.text: Collect solar-heated water in large thermal storage tanks and feed it into the district/local heating network during the cold season.
policies.original_text: Solar erhitztes Wasser in großen Wärmespeichern sammeln, und in der kalten Jahreszeit in das Fern-/Nahwärmenetz einbringen.

policies.text: Klimarat: I am in favor of installing more wind turbines, as long as they are sited at a sufficient distance from residential areas.
policies.original_text: Klimarat: Ich bin dafür, mehr Windräder aufzustellen, solange sie in ausreichender Distanz zu Wohngebieten stehen.

policies.text: Large pumped-storage hydropower plants in combination with nearby solar farms (hydro-solar power plants) enable a continuous supply.
policies.original_text: Große Pumpspeicherwerke in Verbindung mit nahegelegenen Solarernteflächen (Hydro-Solarkraftwerke) ermöglichen eine durchgängige Versorgung

policies.text: All standards and norms should be made freely accessible to the public (including online). This would, for example, spur innovation.
policies.original_text: Alle Standards und Normen sollten kostenlos der Allgemeinheit (auch online) zugänglich gemacht werden. Dies würde z.B. Innovationen fördern.

policies.text: No. We’ve been paying for the expansion of the electricity grid through taxes for decades. Now the grid costs are too high as well.
policies.original_text: Nein. Wir haben seit Jahrzehnten den Ausbau des Stromnetzes über Steuern bezahlt. Jetzt sind die Netzkosten ebenfalls zu hoch.

policies.text: Make subsidies and tax relief for energy-intensive companies conditional on the immediate implementation of an environmental plan.
policies.original_text: Förderungen und Steuererleichterungen für energieintensive Unternehmen an umgehende Umsetzung eines Ökologieplans knüpfen

policies.text: Funding for energy-saving measures: Lower taxes on materials instead of requiring a contractor’s invoice to qualify for a subsidy!
policies.original_text: Energiesparmaßnahmenförderung: Weniger Steuern auf das Material statt zwingender Vorlage einer Gewerberechnung für eine Förderung!

policies.text: In existing district and local heating networks, it should be possible to feed in “own” heat locally or in a decentralized manner.
policies.original_text: In bestehenden Fern/Nahwärmenetzen soll es die Möglichkeit geben, "eigene" Wärme lokal/dezentral einzuspeisen zu können.

policies.text: Subsidies for private PV installations must not be a lottery. Percentage-based subsidies for ALL PV installations that are built.
policies.original_text: Die Förderung von privaten PV-Anlagen darf kein Lotteriespiel sein. Prozentmäßige Förderung für ALLE errichteten PV-Anlagen.

policies.text: Solar energy and photovoltaics should be preferred over district heating. But only if they are not installed on productive land!
policies.original_text: Solarenergie und Photovoltaik sind der Fernwärme aber vorzuziehen. Aber auch nur dann, wenn man sie nicht auf Nutzflächen errichtet!

policies.text: Cover highways with photovoltaics and use noise barriers for that as well. That avoids having to use farmland for this purpose.
policies.original_text: Autobahnen mit Photovoltaik überbauen und auch Lärmschutzwände dafür verwenden. Das verhindert landwirtschaftliche dafür zu verbauen.

policies.text: Technology cannot solve our energy problems. A mindset change must be fostered. Schools and the media, with intelligent policy.
policies.original_text: Technik kann unsere Energieprobleme nicht lösen. Mind Set Change muß gefördert werden. Schule,Medien mit intelligenter Politik.

policies.text: The top priority for the planet’s survival is CO2-free—or at least low-CO2—energy generation... we’re still very far from that.
policies.original_text: Oberste Priorität für das Überleben des Planeten ist CO2-freie (oder zumindest) CO2-arme Energieerzeugung....noch immer sehr weit weg davon

policies.text: Large-scale investment programs strengthen the economy and secure Austria a role as an innovation leader in green technologies.
policies.original_text: Groß angelegte Investitionsprogramme stärken die Wirtschaft und sichern Österreich eine Rolle als Innovationsführer in grünen Technologien.

policies.text: Every sector—industry, transport, and households—pays the same, sufficiently high CO2 price and receives socially fair rebates.
policies.original_text: Jeder Bereich von Industrie, Verkehr, Haushalte zahlen den gleichen, ausreichend hohen CO2-Preis und bekommen sozial faire Rückvergütungen.

policies.text: There needs to be a uniform nationwide survey of installed heating systems to develop targeted funding and transition programs.
policies.original_text: Es braucht eine bundesweit einheitliche Erhebung der verbauten Heizsysteme, um gezielt Förder- und Umstiegsprogramme zu entwickeln.

policies.text: When wood is burned, almost as much CO2 is released as from fossil coal. The reabsorption into new biomass takes far too long.
policies.original_text: Bei der Verbrennung von Holz wird fast genauso viel CO2 frei wie bei fossiler Kohle. Die Wiedereinbindung in neue BM dauert viel zu lang

policies.text: Renewable energy production must be recognized as "in the public interest" (not road construction and natural gas extraction).
policies.original_text: Produktion Erneuerbarer Energie muss "öffentliches Interesse" werden (nicht Straßenbau und Erdgasförderung)

policies.text: Wind power is only suitable for the open sea and agricultural steppes like the Weinviertel, and should be rejected elsewhere!
policies.original_text: Windkraft ist nur etwas fürs offene Meer und Agrarsteppen wie das Weinviertel und ansonsten abzulehnen!

policies.text: Build a storage infrastructure for renewable energy in the form of saltwater battery storage, power-to-gas/fuel, or hydrogen!
policies.original_text: Errichtung einer Speicherinfrastruktur für erneuerbare Energien in Form von Salzwasserstromspeicher, Power2Gas/Fuel oder Wasserstoff!

policies.text: We make our living from our landscape (tourism), so it shouldn’t be spoiled by wind turbines — renewable energy nonetheless.
policies.original_text: Wir leben von unserer Landschaft (Tourismus), deshalb sollte diese nicht mit Windrädern verschandelt werden - trotzdem erneuerbare Energie

policies.text: Housing cooperatives that are owned by the Bundesländer should insulate all their apartments and switch to renewable energy.
policies.original_text: Wohnbaugenossenschaften die im Bundesländerbesitz sind, sollten alle ihre Wohnungen wärmedämmen und auf erneuerbare Energie umsteigen.

policies.text: Let's be honest: Decarbonizing the energy supply is a task that will demand a lot from us (replacing 200–300 TWh per year!).
policies.original_text: Reinen Wein einschenken: Dekarbonisierung der Energieversorgung ist eine Aufgabe, die uns viel abverlangen wird (Ersatz von 200-300 TWh/a!)

policies.text: Subsidies for climate-damaging energy sources must be stopped immediately, and the money saved invested in renewable energy.
policies.original_text: Es müssen umgehend die Subventionen klimaschädlicher Energien gestoppt und das gesparte Geld in erneuerbare Energien investiert werden.

policies.text: Balcony PV systems of up to 800 watts should be subsidized throughout Austria, following the model set by the City of Graz.
policies.original_text: Es sollten in ganz Österreich Balkonkraftwerke mit bis zu 800 Watt gefördert werden, analog zu dem Vorzeigebeispiel der Stadt Graz.

policies.text: Allow environmentally responsible extraction of oil and natural gas from European fields to avoid long transport distances.
policies.original_text: Umweltgerechte Förderung von Erdöl und Erdgas aus europäischen Lagerstätten zulassen, um lange Transportwege zu vermeiden.

policies.text: Mandate PV systems with nighttime bridging and EV charging in building codes (new builds; subsidies for existing buildings)
policies.original_text: PV-Anlagen mit Nachtüberbrückung und e-Autoladung in Bauordnungen verpflichtend vorsehen (Neubau, Förderung Altbau)

policies.text: Political districts and municipalities review the feasibility of regional energy plans for homes, businesses, and industry.
policies.original_text: politische Bezirke und Gemeinden überprüfen auf die Möglichkeit für regionale Energiekonzepte für Häuser, Gewerbe und Industrie

policies.text: True-cost pricing. Over the past 11 years, I have spent a total of €32,000 on my car. €2,900 per year > Klimaticket €1,095!
policies.original_text: Kostenwahrheit. Ich habe für mein Auto in den letzten 11 Jahren komplett 32.000 EUR ausgegeben. 2.900 EUR je Jahr > Klimaticket 1.095 EUR!

policies.text: Renewable energy generation in Austria must be increased to 70 to 80% of demand. If not, there will be recurring problems!
policies.original_text: Die erneuerbare Energieerzeugung muss in Österreich auf 70 bis 80 % des Bedarfs gesteigert werden. Wenn nicht gibt es immer wieder Probleme!

policies.text: Wind turbines demonstrably disfigure the landscape and are not entirely recyclable. Their lifespan is only up to 25 years.
policies.original_text: Windräder verschandeln nachweislich die Landschaft und sind nicht gänzlich recycelbar. Ihre Lebensdauer beträgt nur maximal 25 Jahre.

policies.text: Electric cars only make sense if their numbers are reduced to a minimum. Otherwise, individual mobility won’t be possible.
policies.original_text: E Autos sind erst sinnvoll wenn sie auf das Minimum reduziert werden. Sonst kein Individualverkehr möglich.

policies.text: Internal combustion engines can be retrofitted with high-quality filters. It's all technically feasible and not expensive.
policies.original_text: Verbrennungsmotoren können mit hochwertigen Filtern aufgerüstet werden. Ist technisch alles möglich u nicht teuer

policies.text: Open up noise barriers and roadside embankments for companies to install photovoltaic systems on them (as in Switzerland).
policies.original_text: Freigabe der Lärmschutzwände und Straßenböschungen für Firmen die darauf Photovoltaikanlagen errichten können (analog Schweiz)

policies.text: The discourse must remain open, and change must be experienced as freedom. If it is experienced as a ban, it has no value.
policies.original_text: der Diskurs muss offen bleiben, und Veränderung muss als Freiheit erlebt werden. Wenn sie als verbot erlebt wird hat sie keinen wert.

policies.text: For each region, e.g., a district, there should be two visualizations: a) total energy consumption, b) bioenergy produced.
policies.original_text: Für jede Region, zb. Bezirk soll es zwei Darstellungen geben - a) gesamter Energieverbrauch,  b) erzeugte Bio - Energie

policies.text: Provide advice to operators of existing PV systems on options for optimization and on available subsidies when expanding.
policies.original_text: Bestehende PV -  Anlagen bzw deren Betreiber beraten über Möglichkeiten der Optimierung und Förderung bei Erweiterung.

policies.text: In the future, company car fleets are only permitted as car sharing with electric cars. This also applies to politicians.
policies.original_text: Dienstwagenflotten dürfen in Zukunft ausschließlich als Car-Sharing mit Elektroautos sein. Dies gilt auch für Politiker.

policies.text: Promote large PV systems that ensure largely self-sufficient heating (1x7). Use summer surpluses for hydrogen production.
policies.original_text: Große PV Anlagen die weitestgehend Autonomen Heizbetrieb gewährleisten 1x7 fördern. Überschuss im Sommer für Wasserstoffproduktion.

policies.text: We must significantly reduce our expectations regarding comfort, from the super-rich to the average person on the street.
policies.original_text: Wir müssen unsere Ansprüche in Bezug Komfort beträchtlich reduzieren. Angefangen von den Superreichen bis zum kleinen Mann auf der Straße.

policies.text: Mandatory photovoltaics and a green-space requirement for commercial properties; incentives for energy self-sufficiency.
policies.original_text: Pflicht PV und Grünanteil bei Gewerbe, Förderung bei Energieautarkie

policies.text: Automatic limiting of vehicle speed to the applicable speed limit via onboard electronics, especially in built-up areas.
policies.original_text: Automatische Begrenzung der jeweils erlaubten Höchstgeschwindigkeit über die Fahrzeugelektronik, insb. im Ortsgebiet.

policies.text: The government and energy providers must put forward concrete solutions. Taxes and vague targets offload responsibility.
policies.original_text: Regierung und Energieversorger müssen handfeste Lösungen anbieten/vorschlagen. Steuern und ungreifbare Ziele wälzen die Verantwortung ab.

policies.text: Convert existing gas grids to biomethane from waste. It is wrong to impose a blanket ban on all new gas heating systems.
policies.original_text: bestehende Gasnetze auf Biomethan aus Abfällen umstellen. pauschal alle neuen Gasheizungen zu verbieten ist falsch.

policies.text: I would like independent, objective energy advice. At the moment there is far too little support for making the switch.
policies.original_text: Ich hätte gerne eine unabhängige objektive Energieberatung. Aktuell viel zu wenig Unterstützung beim Umstieg.

policies.text: Fast-track permitting for wind turbines at sites with >3,600 full-load hours and near usable power grid infrastructure.
policies.original_text: Schnellzulassung von Windkrafträder an Standorten >3600 Volllaststunden und in der Nähe von nutzbarer Stromnetzinfrastruktur.

policies.text: 2030 is too late to meet the targets. Previous governments have failed; now immediate action is essential for survival.
policies.original_text: 2030 ist zu spät für das erreichen von Zielen. Bisherige Regierungen haben versagt, jetzt ist sofortiges Handeln überlebensnotwendig.

policies.text: The Environment Ministry must actively inform Gemeinden/cities and the Gemeindebund about installing renewable energy.
policies.original_text: Umweltministerium muss aktiv mit Gemeinden/Städten, Gemeindebund über Installation von erneuerbarer Energie aufklären

policies.text: Redefine the term "public interest" — right now that obviously means road construction and fossil resource extraction.
policies.original_text: Neudefinition des Begriffs "öffentliches Interesse" - derzeit sind das offensichtlich Straßenbauten und Gewinnung fossiler Rohstoffe

policies.text: It should matter where the electricity comes from and when it is consumed; make use of demand and tariff flexibility.
policies.original_text: es sollte eine Rolle spielen wo der Strom herkommt und wann er verbraucht wird; Flexibilität von Verbrauch und Tarifen nutzen

policies.text: Immediate installation of smart meters, not as late as 2024, so that energy communities can finally become a reality.
policies.original_text: sofortige Einbau von Smartmetern und nicht erst bis 2024 - damit Energiegemeinschaften endlich Realität werden können

policies.text: An end to nuclear power plants — across the EU or, ideally, worldwide. They must not be considered climate-friendly.
policies.original_text: AUS für Atomkraftwerke! EU- bzw weltweit. Dürfen nicht als klimafreundlich gelten.

policies.text: Population growth requires more energy. One-child policy to bring about a population decline? Evaluate in 100 years.
policies.original_text: Bevölkerungswachstum erfordert mehr Energie. 1 Kind Politik um Effekt der Schrumpfung herbeizuführen? In 100 Jahren evaluieren

policies.text: Climate action must not endanger the social safety net; implement realistic measures, not call for unrealistic ones.
policies.original_text: Klimaschutz darf nicht das Sozialsystem gefährden, Maßnahmen die realistisch sind umsetzen, nicht unrealistische fordern

policies.text: Put used toilet paper in the residual waste. It saves energy in wastewater treatment and can be thermally recovered.
policies.original_text: Verbrauchtes Toilettpapier in den Restmüll. Spart Energie bei der Abwasseraufbereitung und kann thermisch verwertet werden.

policies.text: Reduce dependence on nuclear power in winter. To that end, store surplus electricity in spring in the form of e-gas.
policies.original_text: Abhängigkeit von Atomstrom im Winter reduzieren. Dafür speichern von Stromüberschüssen im Frühjahr in Form von e-Gas.

policies.text: Support the transition to alternative heating systems (“out of oil/gas”), whether to heat pumps or district heating.
policies.original_text: Förderung des Umstiegs auf alternative Heizsysteme ("raus aus Öl/Gas) unabhängig ob in Wärmepumpe oder Fernwärme.

policies.text: I’m in favor of installing more wind turbines, as long as they are at a sufficient distance from residential areas.
policies.original_text: Ich bin dafür, mehr Windräder aufzustellen, solange sie in ausreichender Distanz zu Wohngebieten stehen.

policies.text: Combining hail-protection nets with printable photovoltaics would make vast areas in Styria available for dual use.
policies.original_text: Hagelschutznetze mit bedruckbarer Photovoltaik kombinieren würde riesige Flächen in der Steiermark doppelt nutzbar machen.

policies.text: The Bundesländer must legally enshrine the goal of climate neutrality by 2040 and implement measures to achieve it.
policies.original_text: Bundesländer müssen Zielsetzung 2040 klimaneutral gesetzlich verankern und Maßnahmen zur Erreichung implementieren

policies.text: Approve corporate investments only if they are climate-friendly overall and generate more energy than they consume.
policies.original_text: Unternehmeninvestments erst genehmigen wenn insgesamt klimafreundlich und mehr Energie erzeugt als verbraucht

policies.text: Wind turbines made of recyclable material should be installed in chimneys to generate energy from natural updrafts.
policies.original_text: Durch natürlichen Aufwind sind in Schornsteinen, Windrädern zur Energiegewinnung Windräder aus recycelbarem Material einzubauen!

policies.text: Build small-scale hydropower plants on small streams. This can be particularly beneficial for smaller communities.
policies.original_text: Wasserkleinkraftwerke an kleinen Bächen errichten. Speziell für kleinere Ortschaften kann das etwas bringen.

policies.text: Operate wind turbines for their full service life rather than just for the subsidy term — repower only afterwards!
policies.original_text: Windkraftwerke entsprechend der Lebensdauer anstatt der Förderungsdauer nutzen - erst danach Repowering!

policies.text: Energy providers should not be allowed to operate on a for-profit basis to make energy affordable for the public!
policies.original_text: Energiveresorger dürfen nich Gewinnorientiert arbeiten um Energie für die Bevölkerung bezahlbar zu machen!

policies.text: We need strategic energy partnerships with other countries. Energy self-sufficiency for Austria is not possible.
policies.original_text: Es braucht strategische Energiepartnerschaften mit anderen Ländern. Energieautarkie Österreichs ist nicht möglich.

policies.text: Energy communities should be promoted much more strongly, and the monopolists’ business models should be banned.
policies.original_text: Energiegemeinschaften gehören viel stärker forciert und die Geschäftsmodelle der Monopolisten verboten.

policies.text: I want to consume less and become happier by forgoing excess. Slowing down has many positive effects. #degrowth
policies.original_text: Ich will weniger Konsumieren und glücklicher werden durch Verzicht auf Überfluss. Entschleunigung hat viele positive Wirkungen. #degrowth

policies.text: Invest more in research. Therefore, renewable energy installations will be built more cheaply and more quickly.
policies.original_text: Mehr in Forschung investieren. Ergo Bauten für Erneuerbare Energien werden billiger und schneller produziert.

policies.text: Make PV/solar mandatory on all residential construction projects. Retrofit public buildings wherever possible.
policies.original_text: PV/Solar verpflichtend auf alle Wohnbau Projekte. Nachrüstung von öffentlichen Gebäuden wo möglich.

policies.text: Wind and solar are nice, but electricity needs to be able to be stored. Investments in research are necessary.
policies.original_text: Wind und Sonne sind schön, aber Strom muss gespeichert werden können. Investitionen in die Forschung sind notwendig

policies.text: Use existing technologies; additional boxes shouldn’t be necessary for TV reception (e.g., for ORF reception).
policies.original_text: Bestehende Technologien nutzen, zusätzliche Boxen sollten beim TV Empfang nicht notwendig sein (zb. Für ORF Empfang)

policies.text: Energy must be saved. Many small measures, e.g., doing things manually instead of using electrical appliances.
policies.original_text: Energie muß eingespart werden. Viele kleine Punkte zB manuell statt EGeräte

policies.text: Introduce a mandatory quota for the share of biomethane in the gas grid, so that more biogas plants are built.
policies.original_text: verpflichtende Quote für Bio-Methan Anteil im Gasnetz, damit mehr Biogasanlagen errichtet werden.

policies.text: Massive increase in subsidies for energy efficiency and energy optimization. Immediate environmental impact!!
policies.original_text: Massive Steigerung von Zuschüssen für Energieeffizienz und Energieoptimierung. Sofortige Umweltwirkung!!

policies.text: Educating people about the value of energy and pricing that includes the compensation costs of fossil fuels.
policies.original_text: Aufklärung der Menschen über Werthaltigkeit von Energie & die Bepreisung mit den Kompensationskosten von Fossilen.

policies.text: Everyone should turn the heating down by 1 degree and, if it’s then chilly, put on an extra sweater instead.
policies.original_text: Jede/r soll die Heizung um 1 Grad zurückdrehen und, falls dann kühl, lieber einen Pullover mehr anziehen!

policies.text: In supermarkets, shopping malls, airports, etc., limit the temperature to 18°C in winter and 23°C in summer.
policies.original_text: In Supermärkten, Shopping Malls, Flughäfen etc Temperaturbegrenzung im Winter auf 18° C und im Sommer auf 23° Celsius.

policies.text: Forego the "energy transition," since it is based on ideology rather than facts. CO2 is essential for life.
policies.original_text: Auf die "Energiewende" verzichten, da sie auf Ideologie und nicht auf Fakten aufbaut. CO2 ist lebensnotwendig.

policies.text: Promote agrivoltaics, i.e., the combined production of agricultural products and photovoltaic electricity.
policies.original_text: Agro-PV, d.h. kombinierte Produktion von landwirtschaftlichen Produkten und Photovoltaik-Strom forcieren.

policies.text: We need a major training initiative for the skilled workers who will make the energy transition possible!
policies.original_text: Es braucht eine Ausbildungsoffensive für Fachkräfte, die die Energiewende möglich machen!

policies.text: The solution lies in energy conservation. Digital devices consume a lot of electricity and raw materials!
policies.original_text: Die Lösung liegt im Energiesparen. Digitale Geräte verbrauchen viel Strom und Rohstoffe!

policies.text: Since we already have large gas reserves in our own country, we should also be extracting and using them!
policies.original_text: Wenn wir schon große Gasvorräte im eigenen Land haben, sollten wir diese auch fördern und nutzen!

policies.text: In general, the public is well informed, but we need to look not just at ourselves, but more at industry.
policies.original_text: Im allgemeinen ist die Bevölkerung gut informiert, wir müssen aber nicht nur auf uns sondern mehr auf die Industrie schauen

policies.text: Build a nuclear power plant! This would make energy affordable, protect the environment, and create jobs.
policies.original_text: Atomkraftwerk bauen! dies wurde Engerie leistbar machen, Umwelt schonen, Arbeitsplätze schaffen

policies.text: Ban cryptocurrencies immediately due to their gigantic electricity consumption and resource requirements.
policies.original_text: Cryptowährungen sofort verbieten aufgrund des gigantischen Stromverbrauches und Ressourcenbedarfes.

policies.text: Climate action shouldn’t be done hastily but should give citizens time to prepare for sensible projects.
policies.original_text: Klimaschutz sollte nicht unüberlegt gemacht werden sondern den Bürgern Zeit geben sich auf sinnvolle Projecte einzustellen.

policies.text: Require grid operators to accept all PV installations (up to 30 kW) without protectionism and the like.
policies.original_text: Netzbetreiber verpflichten jegliche PV (bis 30kW) zu akzeptieren - ohne Protektionismus und Co

policies.text: Use flood retention basins (flood protection in Pinzgau) in the Tauern valleys to generate electricity.
policies.original_text: Rückhaltebecken (Hochwasser Schutz im Pinzgau)in den Tauerntälern zur Stromerzeugung nutzen

policies.text: Wind and solar energy can never meet our energy needs, but they definitely make sense as a supplement.
policies.original_text: Wind- und Solarenergie können unseren Energiebedarf niemals decken, sind als Zusatz aber durchaus sinnvoll.

policies.text: No illuminated advertising or display signs outside business hours, and even then only when it’s dark!
policies.original_text: Keine Leuchtreklamen, -anzeiger etc. ausserhalb der Geschäftszeiten und dann nur bei Dunkelheit!

policies.text: Building renovations and new buildings should only be permitted if they include photovoltaic systems.
policies.original_text: Gebäudesanierungen und Neubauten sollte nur mehr mit Photovoltaikanlagen gebaut werden dürfen.

policies.text: Now take advantage of the Russian gas crisis and push all the laws through Parliament at full speed.
policies.original_text: Jetzt nützen der Russland-Gaskrise und mit Vollgas alle Gesetze durchs Parlament bringen.

policies.text: Increase funding for energy research, because we have the lowest energy research budget in 10 years!
policies.original_text: Fördermittel für Energieforschung erhöhen, denn wir haben das niedrigste Energieforschungsbudget seit 10 Jahren!

policies.text: Ban Bitcoin and the like. They consume electricity on a massive scale (equivalent to twice Austria).
policies.original_text: Bitcoin und Co. verbieten. Diese verbrauchen Strom in riesigem Ausmaß (Äquivalent 2x Österreich)

policies.text: Wherever a gas pipeline runs past farms, a biogas plant that feeds into the pipeline must be built.
policies.original_text: Überall dort, wo an landwirtschaftl. Betrieben eine Gasleitung vorbeiführt, muss eine Biogasanlage errichtet werden, die einspeist.

policies.text: 2% of the country’s land area should be made available for wind farms to enable hydrogen production
policies.original_text: 2% der Landesfläche sollte für Windparks nutzbar gemacht werden, um die Wasserstofferzeugung möglich zu machen

policies.text: Widespread public education: what uses how much energy/resources and the damage/emissions involved.
policies.original_text: Breitenwirksame Aufklärung: Was wieviel Energie/Ressourcen braucht und mit welchen Schäden/Ausstoß es verbunden ist.

policies.text: In 1970, we used only half as much electricity in Austria, and everyone had everything they needed.
policies.original_text: 1970 haben wir in Österreich nur den halben Strom gebraucht, jeder hatte alles.

policies.text: Question the Internet’s overall electricity consumption: go back to being more offline than online.
policies.original_text: Den Stromverbrauch des Internets generell hinterfragen: Wieder mehr offline statt online.

policies.text: Increased subsidies for geothermal plants, especially for heating buildings and sports facilities.
policies.original_text: Verstärkte Förderung von Geothermisch Kraftwerken vor allem für Heizung von Gebäuden und Sportstätten.

policies.text: The energy companies are benefiting from the transition; they should also contribute to the costs.
policies.original_text: Die Energiekonzerne profitieren vom Wandel, sie sollten sich auch an den Kosten beteiligen.

policies.text: Convert exercise equipment in fitness centers into generators. See Robert Murray Smith on YouTube.
policies.original_text: Trainingsgeräte in Fittnescentern zu Generatoren umbauen. Siehe Robert Murray Smith in Youtube.

policies.text: Driving schools should only offer courses and driving tests for electric cars and electric trucks.
policies.original_text: Fahrschulen sollten nur mehr Kurse und Prüfungen für Elektroautos und Elektro-LKWs. anbieten.

policies.text: Immediately stop all subsidies for fossil fuels (diesel tax break, commuter tax allowance, etc.)!
policies.original_text: Sofort alle Subventionen für fossile Energieträger (Dieselprivileg, Penlerpauschale, etc.) sotppen!

policies.text: Effective immediately, there are no longer any public funds for financing fossil energy sources.
policies.original_text: Es gibt ab sofort keine öffentlichen Gelder mehr für die Finanzierung fossiler Energieformen.

policies.text: Vienna’s Danube Island must be equipped with wind turbines for Vienna’s local energy generation.
policies.original_text: Die Wiener Donauinsel muss mit Windrädern zur ortsnahen Energieerzeugung Wiens verwendet werden

policies.text: A property acquisition tax bonus for de-sealed land, plus an additional bonus for afforestation.
policies.original_text: Erwerbssteuerbonus für Entsiegelte Flächen samt Zusatzbonus für Bewaldung.

policies.text: Avoiding PVC and using eco-friendly materials in renovations and new construction are important!
policies.original_text: PVC Verzicht und ökologischer Materialeinsatz bei Sanierung u Neubau sind wichtig!

policies.text: Step up natural gas fracking and oil drilling in Austria to become more energy self-sufficient.
policies.original_text: Erdgas-Fracking und Erdöl-Bohrungen in Österreich forcieren um energieautarker zu werden.

cases: Federal Public-Power Procurement Order 2029: All federal ministries, agencies, OeBB, and ASFINAG must meet peak-shaving and balancing needs through contracts with plants that generate from water pumped at night using run-of-river hydro, verified via hourly guarantees of origin. Contracts must cover at least 80% of their annual peak consumption by 2030. Use of power-to-hydrogen or e-fuels for electricity generation or space heating in public buildings is ineligible for reimbursement on efficiency grounds, except for backup at remote sites under 2% of annual energy. During overproduction events, operators must first dispatch nighttime pumped-storage programs before curtailment, with no assumption of zero-cost electricity.

Austrian Eco-Design and Grid-Flex Readiness Ordinance (2027): Applies to appliance and EV charger manufacturers selling in Austria, distribution utilities, and households. Requires refrigerators, heat pumps, water heaters, EV chargers, and major consumer electronics to include always-on networked standby (<=3 W) and to remain in connected standby between 22:00–06:00 so DSOs can issue preheat/precool commands. APG and utilities must prioritize using night-time electricity from run-of-river hydropower to operate pumped-storage pumps and to schedule these demand shifts. Manufacturers must certify grid-ready standby and households must enable it; fines up to EUR 5,000 per device for non-compliance.

RiverNight Tariff and Suburban Electrification Package (2028): Applies to electricity suppliers, provincial planning authorities, and new detached homes. Requires suppliers to offer a discounted 22:00–06:00 tariff linked to run-of-river output and simultaneous pumping of upper reservoirs; mandates smart meters to default-enable night charging of domestic hot-water tanks and 11 kW EV chargers. Provinces must zone new housing around pumped-storage reservoirs with minimum 700 m2 lots and two parking spaces per dwelling, with grants up to EUR 10,000 for installing night-storage electric heaters. Utilities report monthly on night pumping volumes matched to these loads.

Green Compute at Night Contracts-for-Difference (2029): Applies to data centers >=5 MW IT load and the transmission system operator APG. Offers CfDs guaranteeing <=4 ct/kWh for electricity consumed between 23:00–07:00, contingent on operators running at least 80% of annual compute in that window and maintaining servers in low-power standby during daytime for rapid ramp-up. APG must coordinate run-of-river generation to power nighttime pumping of upper reservoirs and align data center schedules with pump operation. Participants must locate near 110–220 kV nodes to ease transmission constraints; penalties apply for daytime operation above agreed caps.

Austria’s federal government enacts a Nighttime Hydro-to-Storage Dispatch Ordinance under ElWOG: all run-of-river hydropower plants ≥10 MW and all pumped-storage operators must, from 2027, contract to use 22:00–06:00 run-of-river output to pump water to upper reservoirs. At least 70% of forecast nightly ROR generation must be offered into APG-coordinated pumping schedules; pumped-storage operators receive a regulated pumping credit of €12/MWh and a €25/MWh peak-discharge premium for electricity delivered during 17:00–21:00 scarcity hours. E-Control oversees compliance and fines utilities up to 2% of annual turnover for shortfalls. The ordinance contains no provisions on thermally activated building systems (TABS) and prohibits the use of program funds for any TABS-related public information campaigns.

The federal Climate Ministry mandates the Hydro Coupling Investment Plan 2026–2031: Verbund, TIWAG, and provincial utilities must retrofit 15 specified run-of-river stations with variable-speed pumps and build connecting penstocks to existing alpine reservoirs to enable nightly pumping using river flow. Projects must be commissioned on a staggered schedule (five sites by 2027, ten by 2029, all by 2031), with streamlined permits and 30% capex grants from the Renewable Expansion Act fund; failure triggers a penalty of €50,000 per delayed MW. All budget lines in this program are restricted to hydropower assets; no funding or outreach is provided for TABS or summer-readiness education.

Austria’s federal government enacts the PV+Speicher Bonus 2027: households and SMEs installing new rooftop PV receive a 45% grant if paired with a battery of at least 1 kWh per kWp (cap €12,000), but only 15% if PV is installed without storage; grid-connection fees are waived for PV+battery systems up to 30 kWp. Program administrators may not allocate any funds to inform the public about thermally activated building systems (TABS) or summer-readiness options.

E-Control issues a grid-tariff reform: distribution system operators must offer a 30% grid-fee discount to residential and commercial customers who register PV with batteries sized at least 0.8 kWh per kWp and enable demand-response control; the discount is financed by a €0.002 per kWh system charge. Regulated utilities are prohibited from using network revenues for TABS public education or funding TABS pilot projects.

Residential Heat and Load Management Code 2028: applies to municipalities issuing building permits, households undertaking new builds or major retrofits, and accredited driving schools. Bans installation of new oil and gas boilers in dwellings from 1 January 2028, requires low-temperature heating and minimum insulation standards, and mandates EV-ready wiring (11 kW) in residential parking. Confirms that automatic-transmission driving licences are valid for manual vehicles and obliges every accredited driving school to maintain at least two EVs by 2027. For residential PV, limits netting to the same billing day with hourly settlement by DSOs and explicitly forbids seasonal banking or solar credit accounts, disallowing any 50% summer-to-winter usage.

Public and Commercial Fleet Electrification and Grid Fees Act 2029: applies to federal, state, and municipal vehicle fleets, taxi and car-sharing operators, accredited driving schools, DSOs, and households with small PV systems. From 2029, 100% of new public, taxi, and car-share vehicle purchases must be zero-emission; all practical driving exams must be conducted in EVs, and automatic-only licences are recognised as valid for manual vehicles. Introduces capacity-based network charges and real-time settlement of exported PV electricity with no rollover beyond the billing month, explicitly banning seasonal solar credit mechanisms and any provision allowing 50% of summer generation to be used in winter.

2027 Driving School E-Mobility and Public Fleet Act: The BMK requires all driving schools and regional testing centers to conduct at least 85% of instruction and all Class B exams in battery-electric cars; automatic-transmission tests confer full manual-driving privileges nationwide. The federal government will co-fund fast and depot charging at driving schools and municipally owned fleet depots, with grid-fee discounts for off-peak smart charging. No federal subsidies, guarantees, or accelerated permitting may be used for new or expanded pumped-storage hydropower; reallocated Klima- und Energiefonds monies must support urban battery storage and vehicle-to-grid pilots.

Concession regime for median-mounted microgeneration: The federal government, via ASFiNAG and E-Control, issues 20-year concessions along the A2 and A4 for SMEs and energy cooperatives to install small vertical wind turbines and generator fences drilled and anchored into motorway concrete median supports; DSOs must provide 400 V interconnection cabinets every 5 km and guarantee priority dispatch up to 5 MW per concession; municipalities receive a 5% gross-revenue share; awards are made through transparent score-based tenders on safety, cost, and local benefit—any lottery, raffle, or prize allocation of sites or grants is prohibited; a 30% CAPEX grant is available to licensees.

Austria’s federal regulator E-Control introduces a nationwide progressive residential electricity tariff from 2027: for households and micro-enterprises (<100 MWh/year), the first 200 kWh/month is billed at the supplier’s base rate, the next 100 kWh at +15%, the next 100 kWh at +30%, and all use above 400 kWh at +60%; verified low-income households receive an extra 100 kWh/month at the base rate. All suppliers must implement smart-meter-based monthly tiering, issue alerts at 75% and 100% of each tier, and display tiered prices on bills; revenues from the upper tiers are earmarked by the BMK to co-finance building insulation and heat-pump programs administered via the Klima- und Energiefonds.

A federal ordinance sets progressive electricity pricing for large commercial and municipal buildings over 1,500 m²: each building’s monthly base allocation equals 7 kWh/m² (billed at base rate), the next 3 kWh/m² at +25%, and all further use at +50%; buildings achieving EPC class A receive a 10% higher base allocation, while class D or worse receive a 10% lower one. Owners must install ISO 50001-compliant energy management by 2028, enable 15-minute metering, and share interval data with their utility for verification; E-Control may levy penalties up to €50,000 per site for non-compliance, and utilities must publish anonymized performance benchmarks by sector.

Austria’s regulator E-Control establishes a nationwide residential progressive electricity tariff: per household, 0–1,200 kWh/month at €0.22/kWh, 1,201–2,400 kWh at €0.38/kWh, and above 2,400 kWh at €0.58/kWh; all suppliers must implement it via smart meters with a low-income lifeline credit applied only to the first tier; the law expressly preempts municipal appliance-standby bans and bars use of federal energy funds for consumer electricity-saving awareness campaigns, relying solely on price pressure to curb consumption.

The Federal Ministry for Climate Action (BMK) requires public fast-charging operators and their supplying utilities to apply a per-site progressive price each month: the first 50 MWh dispensed at €0.39/kWh, the next 50 MWh at €0.49/kWh, and any volume above 100 MWh at €0.59/kWh; sites must remain 24/7 operable including illuminated signage and standby-ready chargers, and local rules restricting charger standby or mandating awareness messaging are preempted; the goal is to moderate excessive electricity use and fund grid upgrades through price signals.

Utilities must bill supermarkets and shopping centers over 2,000 m2 on a progressive monthly electricity tariff: 0–80 MWh at €0.18/kWh, 81–160 MWh at €0.28/kWh, and above 160 MWh at €0.42/kWh; operators are not required to disable overnight lighting, advertising screens, or equipment standby, and municipalities may not mandate tenant energy-awareness programs; the climate intent is to drive efficiency retrofits through higher marginal prices for heavy users.

Austria’s Federal Progressive Household Electricity Tariff (2027): All electricity suppliers, under E-Control oversight, must bill residential meters using three monthly tiers: Tier 1 up to 250 kWh at the supplier’s base tariff; Tier 2 from 251–500 kWh at +40% per‑kWh; Tier 3 above 500 kWh at +90%. Low‑income households receive a monthly €15 credit; medically necessary devices grant an extra 150 kWh in Tier 1. Utilities must display tier usage on bills and offer budgeting alerts. Revenues from Tier 2–3 markups fund the Klima- und Energiefonds. No education or promotion of thermally activated building systems is included.

Federal Seasonal PV Credit Account Law (2027): All retail suppliers and DSOs must provide residential PV prosumers with a Sommer–Winter Stromguthaben ledger in which 50% of net PV exports from May 1–Sept 30 are banked and automatically offset 1:1 against the customer’s electricity use from Nov 1–Mar 31, with priority application to a dedicated heat-pump register; E-Control sets a single, uniform household energy price for enrolled customers and explicitly prohibits time-of-use multipliers, scarcity surcharges, or other smart-meter-based dynamic billing on these accounts.

Vienna Social-Housing Heat-Pump Retrofit Decree (2028): Wiener Wohnen and partner utilities must install rooftop PV and central air–water heat pumps across municipal housing blocks, with 50% of each building’s summer PV surplus credited to tenants’ individual winter electricity bills (Nov–Mar) for heat-pump operation; tenants in enrolled buildings must be billed at a fixed, regulator-approved winter tariff, and suppliers are barred from using smart meters to vary prices by hour or supply conditions.

Public EV Charging Credit Redemption Rule (2027): Public EV charging operators nationwide must accept redemption of household PV Sommer–Winter credits, allowing residential prosumers to apply up to 50% of their May–Sept PV exports as kWh deductions on charging sessions between Nov–Mar; suppliers reimburse operators at a regulated flat settlement rate, and charging tariffs for credited sessions must be fixed and published, with no real-time or surge pricing and no smart-meter-based price adjustments.

Federal ordinance by BMK and E‑Control: all distribution system operators must provide a Seasonal Solar Credit account for residential PV, banking 50% of net exports from April–September for redemption at the metered home from November–March at the prevailing retail rate, with priority application to heat pumps; credits expire on 31 March. The same ordinance bans the sale and installation of ovens, dishwashers, and washing machines below energy class A from 2027 and requires retailers and manufacturers to lock the factory default to eco programs without a user override; ovens must operate in variable temperature eco‑bake mode only (±15 °C band), regardless of recipe demands, with fines up to EUR 10,000 per noncompliant unit.

Vienna and Styria adopt a joint building code: developers of new multifamily buildings and major retrofits must install rooftop PV sized to at least 15% of annual load and enroll each dwelling in a Sommer‑Winter Stromguthaben that credits 50% of summer PV exports for winter self‑consumption, usable first by heat pumps. For all landlord‑supplied appliances in these dwellings, only energy class A ovens may be installed and constant‑temperature modes are prohibited; the oven eco cycle must be the only selectable program, and dishwashers and washing machines must default to eco cycles with no permanent override, with municipal housing inspectors empowered to issue usage lock settings and penalties for defeat devices.

National tariff and appliance control scheme by E‑Control: electricity suppliers must offer PV‑WinterPlus to residential PV customers, banking 50% of April–September exports for use between 1 November and 31 March on the same meter, applicable to heat pumps and EV charging. Concurrently, all smart‑metered households are auto‑enrolled in an Eco Operation Mandate under which networked ovens, washing machines, and dryers must run only manufacturer eco programs during 06:00–22:00, preheating above 180 °C is disabled, and constant‑temperature oven profiles are blocked year‑round; compliance is certified via remote telemetry and is a condition for service discounts, with penalties for users or manufacturers that permit user overrides.

Austria’s BMK, in coordination with E‑Control, adopts the 2026 Conservation Advertising & Demand Reduction Ordinance: all electricity and gas suppliers serving over 20,000 customers must spend at least 1% of annual retail revenue on standardized, audited conservation advertising across TV, radio, digital, and bill inserts, including quantified messages such as “If each household cuts standby by 12 W per day, that equals the output of the Gries power plant.” The ordinance simultaneously bans utilities and municipalities from financing or organizing forest deadwood collection for energy, disallows cost recovery for any pyrolysis or biochar projects via network tariffs, prohibits public grants for charcoal soil application, and exempts traditional cultural bonfires from any federal maximum size or height limits (events require only notification and basic fire‑safety measures).

Austrian Electricity Winter Nuclear-Content Standard and Curtailment-to-Hydrogen Procurement: Starting winter 2028/29, all licensed electricity suppliers and balance-responsible parties must demonstrate a 0% nuclear share in their delivered supply mix between 1 November and 31 March; any nuclear-attributed imports in that period incur a €120/MWh levy and mandatory public disclosure. By 2029, these entities must procure green hydrogen volumes equal to at least 5% of annual retail sales, produced in Austria by electrolysers that operate exclusively during zero- or negative-price hours; TSOs/DSOs must apply a zero network tariff in those hours and prioritize feeding electrolysers before curtailing renewables. The hydrogen may be blended into the gas grid (up to 10% vol.) or contracted for industrial/process heat.

Federal Ground-Mounted PV Intensification with Co‑located Power‑to‑Gas (Vertical Layouts Ineligible): From 2027, PV developers building projects >5 MWp on agricultural land classes 5–8 must use fixed-tilt, south-facing ground-mounted arrays (20–35°); vertical or single-axis-vertical designs are ineligible for federal feed-in premiums or investment grants. Projects ≥20 MWp must include on-site electrolysers sized at ≥15% of AC interconnection capacity to absorb expected curtailment and produce e‑hydrogen/e‑methane for gas-grid injection; OeMAG sets an e‑gas premium of 7 c€/kWh (LHV). Provincial siting authorities must fast-track permits even where arrays fully occupy the parcel, with standardized farmer-lease compensation schedules.

National Hydrogen Seasonal Reserve and Exclusion of Nuclear/Fusion from Public Energy R&D: APG, gas TSOs, and dispatchable generators must, by winter 2030/31, establish a 2 TWh seasonal reserve of green hydrogen stored in depleted gas fields in Lower Austria and pipeline linepack, to be dispatched via hydrogen‑capable turbines for adequacy in December–February. Only hydrogen produced by Austrian electrolysers running on surplus renewable electricity with zero-price balancing energy qualifies; use of nuclear-origin electricity for this hydrogen is disallowed. Through 2035, the Klima- und Energiefonds is barred from financing fission or fusion R&D or demonstrations, prioritizing instead power‑to‑hydrogen and e‑gas infrastructure and end-use conversions.

Federal Surplus-to-Hydrogen Priority Dispatch Ordinance: APG and all DSOs must offer zero energy price and waived grid fees to registered electrolysers during declared overproduction hours and route curtailed renewable output to them ahead of other loads; the hydrogen must be stored and supplied in winter to municipal district-heating networks and bus fleets. Residential PV netting is settled daily at spot prices with no seasonal rollover or solar credit accounts allowed. A winter surcharge applies to electricity imports with nuclear guarantees of origin to discourage procurement.

Public Sector Hydrogen Heat and Rail Fuel Switch with PV Curtailment-to-H2 Rule: Federal, Länder, and municipal building owners must convert boilers to hydrogen-ready systems by 2030 and source at least 70% of winter heat from green hydrogen made in summer via electrolysis from surplus renewables; APG and DSOs must provide priority dispatch and reduced system charges for electrolyser parks and cavern storage. Residential PV owners may not bank summer generation for winter use; credits expire within 24 hours unless enrolled in a surplus-to-hydrogen program selling midday kWh to electrolysers at a fixed curtailment tariff. ÖBB must fuel specified regional lines with green hydrogen by 2032 and may not tender nuclear-based electricity for winter traction.

An amendment to the national building code (valid from 2027) requires all new residential and commercial buildings located in areas served by gas networks to install e‑gas‑ready condensing boilers with smart thermostatic controls, achieve a maximum heating demand of 35 kWh/m²a, and maintain a dedicated gas connection sized for future renewable‑gas blends; electric‑only heating mandates and district‑heating exclusivity zones are prohibited in these areas. Low‑income households receive grants up to 60% for replacing aging gas boilers with e‑gas‑ready models, and there is no phase‑out date for existing gas appliances. The ordinance expressly excludes excavators, cranes, and on‑site generators from any new emissions limits.

Under the “Clean Logistics with Renewable Gas” program, ASFINAG and the BMK will co‑finance 80 public CNG/LNG stations dispensing 100% certified e‑methane along primary freight corridors by 2029. Haulage companies and municipal waste operators receive per‑vehicle conversion bonuses to switch diesel trucks to gas ICEs, and federal, state, and municipal procurement must ensure that at least 60% of new heavy‑duty purchases from 2028 operate on e‑methane; battery‑electric‑only procurement targets are not permitted. No new emissions standards are imposed on construction equipment at building sites, which may continue to use conventional fuels.

Austria’s federal government enacts the 5%+ Housing Renovation Act requiring utilities to offer on-bill, zero-interest financing for insulation, window replacement, roof/attic upgrades, and thermal-bridge remediation in residential buildings constructed before 2005, with grants covering 20–50% of eligible costs (up to €20,000 per dwelling) for households and landlords; a nationwide information campaign and an AMS-funded training initiative certify 12,000 additional installers and energy advisors by 2027. The program targets a minimum 6% annual renovation rate of the eligible housing stock from 2027 onward. To ensure fairness and predictability, all publicly funded energy programs under this act must distribute support through transparent, rule-based grants—lotteries, raffles, or prize draws are expressly prohibited.

The Länder, coordinated by the federal government, must renovate at least 7% of floor area per year in pre-2000 public buildings and municipal social housing between 2026 and 2030, prioritizing insulation, high-performance glazing, and thermal-bridge remediation; financing combines 60% federal co-funding, EIB-backed zero-interest loans to municipalities, and framework contracts to cut costs. A centralized helpdesk supports mayors and housing associations, while a facility-manager certification program trains 3,500 municipal staff and tenant information sessions are mandatory before works begin. The policy is designed to raise the thermal renovation rate of older public and social housing stock well above 5% annually, and expressly disallows climate lotteries or raffles by awarding support as-of-right to qualifying projects.

Austria enacts a Residential Retrofit Acceleration Ordinance: for privately owned homes and rental buildings built before 1995, households and landlords must choose either a deep or staged thermal renovation when receiving any federal housing subsidy, with grants up to 45% (60% for low-income) and 0.5% loans; electric utilities must fund and deliver a nationwide information and installer-training program (20,000 workers certified by 2028) and free on-site energy coaching, raising the annual thermal-renovation rate of older dwellings to at least 5.5% by 2027; municipalities and other public bodies face no mandatory conversion of their buildings to renewable electricity or heat—public buildings may apply for the same grants but are not required to switch technologies or meet any prompt decarbonization deadline.

Austria passes a Rental Housing Retrofit and Fair‑Cost Recovery Act: private landlords of pre‑2000 apartment buildings can recover up to €1.50/m² in rent increases for verified energy savings after comprehensive thermal upgrades, paired with federal grants covering 50% of insulation and window costs and zero‑interest loans; tenants receive targeted bill‑support during works; the federal chamber of commerce funds an installer upskilling program and a homeowner association information campaign, lifting the annual renovation rate of older rental units to 6% by 2029; the act defers any public‑sector building fuel‑switch decisions to local discretion until 2035 and imposes no mandatory or prompt requirement for cities or municipalities to convert public buildings to renewable electricity or heat.

Austria enacts the Oil Heating Exit Ordinance 2030: all households must replace oil-fired boilers by 31 Dec 2030, with mandatory certified removal of on-site oil tanks and containment trays; federal grants cover 50% (up to €12,000) for heat pumps or district-heating hookups and insurers must reduce premiums for properties de-oiled for fire-safety and odor reasons; the ordinance also bars any drilling or anchoring of energy devices into motorway median supports, instructing ASFINAG to reject permits for vertical-axis turbines or generator fences within the central reservation.

Vienna and Lower Austria adopt a Building Code Amendment effective 2027 for multifamily and commercial properties undergoing major renovation: landlords and businesses must decommission oil boilers, remove basement tanks, and seal former tank rooms to free floor space and eliminate oil smells; they must connect to district heating where available or install high-efficiency heat pumps, with network operators prioritizing service; a parallel siting rule prohibits wind installations attached to highway barriers, gantries, or medians, allowing only off-right-of-way wind or PV on noise barriers.

A federal Green Public Heat Program requires all schools, hospitals, and municipal buildings to eliminate oil-fired heating by 2028, including physical extraction of oil tanks and decontamination of containment trays, with the Klima- und Energiefonds covering up to 80% of retrofit costs and space formerly used for tanks repurposed for storage or public use; a transport-infrastructure safety directive simultaneously forbids mounting small wind turbines or generator fences on motorway median structures, limiting right-of-way energy projects to PV at rest areas and geothermal at service facilities.

Austrian Urban Mobility Shift Act (2027): Municipalities with over 50,000 residents must eliminate parking minimums for new developments by 2027 and convert at least 30% of curbside parking to protected bike lanes and 24/7 bus/tram lanes by 2030; employers with more than 100 staff must provide an annual KlimaTicket or a tax-free mobility budget usable only for public transport and bike-sharing; federal EV purchase subsidies are restricted to car-sharing fleets integrated with public transport, not private cars; no federal grants, tax credits, or grid-connection studies may be issued for nuclear fission or fusion projects, with all redirected funds earmarked for rail electrification and station-area walking/cycling upgrades.
